species: Proteome-wide profiling of protein lysine acetylation in Aspergillus flavus
tissue: The mycelia of A. flavus were harvested after 48 h cultivation for protein extraction and subsequent Kac analysis.
sample_source: To evaluate the extent of acetylation in the A. flavus proteome, protein extracts derived from A. flavus CA43 grown on PDA medium were subjected to SDS-PAGE and western blot analysis using an anti-acetyl-lysine antibody (Fig 1).
age: The mycelia of A. flavus were harvested after 48 h cultivation for protein extraction and subsequent Kac analysis.
strain: A. flavus CA43, the S-strain isolates capable of producing numerous sclerotia and high concentrations of aflatoxin, was kindly provided by Professor Perng-Kuang Chang
